description: Linux kernel driver source code for GCA230718 LED support via I2C, managing RGBW LEDs connected to the GCA230718 chip.

classes.name: gca230718_led
classes.description: Represents an individual LED with brightness state, associated I2C client, and LED class device.

classes.name: gca230718_private
classes.description: Holds private data for the driver, including mutex lock and array of LEDs.

methods.name: gca230718_init_private_led_data
methods.description: Initializes the private data structure, setting all LED client pointers to NULL.

methods.name: gca230718_send_sequence
methods.description: Sends initialization or update sequences to the LED controller over I2C, setting brightness levels.

methods.name: gca230718_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of a specific LED and updates the hardware via I2C.

methods.name: gca230718_probe
methods.description: Probe function called during device initialization, sets up LEDs and sends initial sequences.

methods.name: gca230718_remove
methods.description: Cleanup function called during device removal, destroys mutex and resets private data.
